senses.gloss: f. (נטר; cmp. הִטְּרִי a. טָרִית) prop. something preserved, hence dough preserved, vermicelli.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:4:2">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵈ</cite> bot. as I intend making <he>אצוותי א׳</he> my dough into vermicelli.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9:3">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵈ</cite> <he>הדא אטריתא וכ׳</he> to make verm. (on Holy Days), if for drying them, it is forbidden &c.
